figurative_meaning_en: Embarking on a journey on the first day of the Bhadra month or the first day of any month, considered inauspicious or prohibited
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজ প্রতিপদ, অগস্ত্যযাত্রা করে কোনো লাভ নেই।
ভাদ্র মাসের শুরুতে অগস্ত্যযাত্রা এড়িয়ে চলুন।
example_sentences_in_english: Today is the first of the month; there's no point in an Agastya journey.
Avoid an Agastya journey at the start of Bhadra month.
history: Derived from the legend of Sage Agastya in Hindu mythology, whose southern journey is linked to astrological beliefs making certain travel days inauspicious in Bengali culture.
note: The idiom reflects traditional Hindu calendar superstitions prevalent in rural and semi-urban Bengali society.
